title: ABC Patterns
short: Find what comes next in a pattern of three.

blocks.html: A pattern can have three different things: apple, banana, pear, apple, banana, pear. What comes after banana? Pear!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Apple, banana, pear … what comes next?

blocks.html: In an ABC pattern, three things take turns in the same order.

For the grown-up: Build ABC patterns with three colors of blocks or three kinds of snacks. Sing a three-part movement song: touch head, shoulders, knees, again and again. Stop while it is still fun. Then go and play the real-life version.

items: Try it at home: Touch head, shoulders, knees, again.
Line up three colors of blocks.
